data: What is the value of TEXT-LEVEL for the bottom-most NUCLEUS node?

The question asks for the value of TEXT-LEVEL for the bottom-most NUCLEUS node. From the provided information, we can see that there are two NUCLEUS nodes at the bottom of the figure. The leftmost one is labeled "ban(fda, elixir)" and the rightmost one is labeled "contain(elixir, gestodene)". Both have the same TEXT-LEVEL value of {0..4}. Therefore, the value of TEXT-LEVEL for the bottom-most NUCLEUS node is {0..4}.
